sentence: Every genus $g \ge 0$ exists for each region type $\left(\frac{x}{d}\right)\in\{-1,0,+1\}$ of the cells $(x, d)$ of the hexagonal grid, the proof is constructive, and more generally an algorithm can construct shapes which are not obstructed by divisibility.
